review:
Big Bass Hold & Spinner Megaways was billed as the tenth Big Bass title and brings the series onto a six-reel Megaways layout. The number of symbols on each reel changes every spin, creating up to 147,456 ways to win, and winning symbols cascade away so new icons can fall in. Mystery symbols can also land and reveal a matching symbol.

There are two bonuses. The free spins round keeps the multiplier and retrigger system but now allows unlimited retriggers. The hold and spin bonus gives three respins to land instant cash prizes, with each new prize resetting the count. The combination of Megaways and cascades makes this one of the most volatile-feeling Big Bass games, and it advertises the highest top win in this batch at 20,000x. The 96.7% RTP is also strong.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
